verdict.rationale: The only evidence of snoozing is an indirect community note about the free plan that mentions snoozed emails still arriving back in the inbox. This implies Shortwave has a snooze that resurfaces threads. There is no first-party documentation of snooze, and no evidence of follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies. Scheduled send and todos are separate features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of snooze, any evidence of no-reply follow-up reminders, and hands-on corroboration of resurfacing behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: snoozed emails past that window won't show up in search results (though they still arrive in the inbox)
